subject: prd/implement-now
statement: When the already-selected harness receives a plan/v2 or translated plan/v1 execution profile for the implementation role, that harness adapter shall select the least-cost qualified native profile satisfying every capability, deliberation, context, and assurance minimum under the effective closed, version-compatible routing policy; an exact result is preferred and a stronger result is permitted only as a recorded promotion naming every promoted component.
rationale: harness catalogs differ, while the frozen semantic floor and least-powerful-that-suffices policy must remain stable
fit_criterion: exhaustive harness×derivable-profile implementation-role conformance proves every resolved cell selects the cheapest qualified dominating native profile; exact and promoted fixtures record the expected result; native identifiers appear only in adapter policy and attempt evidence
